common_name: Maestro Hellebore (Gold Collection Marbled-Leaf Winter Hellebore)

planting.note: Plant container-grown divisions in fall or early spring in humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; Maestro is a Gold Collection hybrid (breeder code 'COSEH 890', US Plant Patent 23,859) grown chiefly for its heavily silver-marbled evergreen foliage.

directions: Site divisions in humus-rich, evenly moist but well-drained soil in partial shade, ideally where winter sun can light up the patterned leaves. Maestro's main draw is its leathery, spine-toothed foliage, strongly veined and marbled in silvery gray over dark green, which stays handsome through most of the year. Nodding flowers open creamy rose with yellow nectaries in late winter and deepen to a richer pink as they age through the following weeks. As with other ballardiae hybrids it is sterile and propagated only by division or tissue culture, so established clumps should be left undisturbed for several years between divisions.
